$otSharedSchema.description: The path to a valid Opentrons shared schema relative to the shared-data directory, without its extension. For instance, #/pipette/schemas/2/pipetteGeometrySchema.json is a reference to this schema.

apiLoadName.description: The name that can be used to load a pipette in a protocol, like flex_8channel_1000.

familyName.description: The name of this family, which should be treated as opaque and may not correlate with any other name

pipetteModelPrefix.description: The name of the pipette used inside the Python, like p300_single (the version is appended - generation is not in this string).

pipetteName.description: The name of the pipette as reported out of the robot software, like p1000_single_flex (generation is in this string)

displayName.description: A human-oriented name for the pipette.

model.description: the model of the pipette, for example p1000. Try not to use this.
